name: GetFileByPath
description: Retrieves a file or item from Microsoft 365 SharePoint using its full path via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access SharePoint files via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path of the file in SharePoint or OneDrive (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/File.txt).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the file metadata and content details.
